steps.name: parallel-workers-before
command: SELECT datname, pg_stat_get_db_parallel_workers_launched(oid) AS parallel_workers_launched FROM pg_database WHERE datname = current_database();

steps.name: parallel-workers-after
command: SELECT datname, pg_stat_get_db_parallel_workers_launched(oid) AS parallel_workers_launched FROM pg_database WHERE datname = current_database();
